_readme: Task presets (LM-7). Pick a TASK, not a model name: Hutch resolves each preset to a local model that fits this machine, with a hosted model to escalate to. Edit by copying to <state dir>/presets.json. `local` lists candidates best-first per hardware tier; the resolver takes the best one that fits (preferring models already installed). Local picks are suggestions to be MEASURED on your machine (`hutch models bench`), not guarantees. The hosted pick defaults to claude-opus-5-5; cheaper picks (claude-sonnet-5-5, claude-haiku-4-5) are one edit away and priced in prices.json.

vision.title: Vision
vision.description: Tunes local context and residency for vision-capable models, but Hutch chat cannot attach or send images yet. DOM-based browser control needs no vision model.
